Overview.name: Simon Malzard
Overview.label: AI Research Scientist
Overview.summary: AI Researcher with a background in theoretical physics and mathematics. Experienced in quantum computing, machine learning, and data science. Passionate about applying AI to solve complex problems. Interests include: explainability, mechanistic interpretability, probabilistic modelling and uncertainty quantification.

Experience.name: The Alan Turing Institute
Experience.summary: Building AI systems for adoption in real-world scenarios, focusing on model robustness in human action recognition systems, reducing the human-in-the-loop burden with explainability synthetic data modifications generated from CAD models.

Experience.name: Faculty AI
Experience.summary: Worked on a project to improve the efficiency of data processing pipelines using machine learning techniques.

Certificates and Awards.title: Nobel Prize in Physics
Certificates and Awards.summary: The Nobel Prizes are five separate prizes that, according to Alfred Nobel's will of 1895, are awarded to 'those who, during the preceding year, have conferred the greatest benefit to humankind.'

publications.name: Zur Elektrody/namik bewegter Körper
publications.summary: It concerned an interpretation of the Michelson–Morley experiment and the properties of light and time. Special relativity incorporates the principle that the speed of light is the same for all inertial observers regardless of the state of motion of the source.
